ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: libvpx (WebM project): VP8 decoder, VP9 encoder and decoder, portable C build
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The sources of libvpx v1.15.0 listed by its configure for --target=generic-gnu --enable-vp8-decoder --disable-vp8-encoder --enable-vp9 --enable-multithread --disable-vp9-highbitdepth --disable-postproc. The configuration it generated is in 'generated'; HAVE_PTHREAD_H is switched off on Windows so libvpx uses its Win32 threads.
